verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly say Gitea tracks requirements, features, and bugs through issues. They also list milestones, time tracking, due dates, and dependencies as issue features, alongside labels and kanban boards. Every element of the story is named, but only as one-line feature-list claims. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how milestones, time tracking, and dependencies work, independent or hands-on corroboration of these issue-tracking features
